# BSPrep Ambassador Program

Welcome to the BSPrep Ambassador Program portal. This platform is used for managing ambassadors, tracking their progress, and providing resources for promoting BSPrep.

## Important Links
- [Home](https://ambassador.bsprep.in/)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://ambassador.bsprep.in/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://ambassador.bsprep.in/privacy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://ambassador.bsprep.in/cookies)
- [Overview Document](https://ambassador.bsprep.in/docs/bsprep_overview.pdf)

## Application Structure
- `/dashboard/*` - Ambassador dashboard (requires login)
- `/admin/*` - Admin dashboard (requires login)
